parameters.subject: How are the worksheets going?

parameters.content:
## Before activating
1. Connect credentials: open each Gmail node and select your Gmail OAuth2 credential; open Log to Sheet and select your Google Sheets credential.
2. Replace owner@example.com in Notify Owner with your email.
3. Create a Google Sheet with a tab named Sales and headers: Date | Order ID | Name | Email | Product | Amount | Currency — paste its ID into Log to Sheet.
4. Click Execute Workflow, copy the TEST webhook URL, send the test payload (see TESTING note), then Activate.
5. After publish: add the PRODUCTION webhook URL in Lemon Squeezy → Settings → Webhooks (event: order_created).
